mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, biz_domain_id, type_key, type_value, name, description, sort_order, created_by, updated_by, deleted_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, delete_flag FROM type_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND type_key = #{typeKey} AND delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, type_value ASC, id ASC
